facts.label: There was e there were
facts.sub: Use there was com uma coisa e there were com várias. Nas negativas, there wasn’t e there weren’t. Pergunte Was there a free breakfast? e responda Yes, there was.

facts.label: Reclamações
facts.sub: Reclame com calma e dê fatos: There was no hot water, there were no clean towels. Evite acusar. O objetivo é resolver o problema, e gerentes costumam colaborar quando ouvem fatos.

facts.label: There was / were
facts.sub: Use there was com algo no singular e there were com vários. There was a problem. There were two problems. Para negar, there wasn’t e there weren’t.
